 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to Crime No.22/2024 registered at Police Station - Mata Basaiya, District - Morena (M.P.)
for the offence under Sections 376, 506, 120-B, 109 and 376(D) of IPC.
First application was dismissed as withdrawn by order dated 06.8.2024 passed in MCRC No. 29885 of 2024.
Learned counsel for the applicant / accused argued that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated.

After withdrawal of first bail application, prosecutrix as well as her mother have been examined before the trial Court, however, there are material contradictions and omissions in her statements recorded under Sections 161 and 164 Cr..C. with her court- statement.
It is further argued that allegedly, the incident occurred on 06.2.2024.

Even though prosecutrix is a major lady having knowledge about NEUTRAL CITATION NO. 2024:MPHC-GWL:22008 2 MCRC-44675-2024 legal procedures, FIR has been lodged after a delay of 14 days on 19.2.2024 for which no plausible explanation has been given.
Further argument is that applicant has not been identified in the T.I.P. and the DNA report is also negative in respect to present applicant.
Under these circumstances case of the prosecution becomes doubtful.
It is further argued that applicant is in custody since 21.2.2024.
Further custodial interrogation of the applicant is not required.
Further argument is that applicant is the permanent resident of District - Morena (M.P.) having no criminal antecedents.

Since evidence of the prosecutrix has already been recorded, therefore, question of Sanjay Nath vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 11 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/31884745/
1 influencing her does not arise.

sentences.text: Hence, prayed for grant of bail to the applicant.
On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the bail application and prayed for its rejection.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
